integrity: All-dimensional analytic proof with supplementary finite, exhaustive, independently constructed graph checks for dimensions one through six; no independent external audit.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for the cubical bipolar combinatorial type, not general bipolar polytopes.
Graph distance is combinatorial, not Euclidean.
Priority may be affected by results on cube-face Hasse graphs under other terminology.
title: Pole-shortcut metric and diametral pairs in cubical bipolar polytopes
